single.rationale: Criteo shows strong profitability improvement (operating margin expanding from 1.2% to 10.4% over three years) and excellent capital allocation (share buybacks, 22% FCF yield, 6.6x P/E). However, flat revenue growth (-1.2% 3-year CAGR), concentration risks with largest customer curtailing services, a major retailer bankruptcy, and execution risks around domicile conversion and business transformation warrant caution before deeper commitment.
